title.ja: ワグナリアへようこそ♪小鳥遊, 働く.
title.en: Welcome to Wagnaria: Takanashi Goes to Work.

1.summary:
A high school boy that loves small, cute things starts working at the family restaurant, Wagnaria, a nest of abnormal fruitcakes. Just as he is acclimating to his new environment, he meets a young woman who will alter his fate for good.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 伊波, 男性恐怖症. だって怖いんだもん...
title.en: Inami, the Androphobic, Because... She`s Scared!
title.x-jat: Inami, Dansei Kyoufushou. Datte Kowain da mon...

2.overview: Souta meets Mahiru, who suffers from Androphobia, the fear of men.  The rest of the staff sets them up to share shifts in a suicidal, for Souta at least, attempt to cure Mahiru.
2.summary:
No sooner had Sota met Inami than she punched him in the face. He soon learns that Inami has a habit of reflexively punching men on sight. Kyoko orders them to break the ice and help each other out with their respective personality flaws.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 八千代と杏子と佐藤... と, 帰ってきた音尾さん
title.en: Yachiyo and Sato, and Otoo-san Returns
title.x-jat: Yachiyo to Kyouko to Satou... to, Kaette Kita Otoo-san

3.overview:
Yachiyo, the samurai sword-carrying waitress, reveals that she started carrying it to ward off bullies back in elementary school.  At this time she encounters Kyoko who agrees to act as a bodyguard in exchange for Yachiyo's lunch.

Otou Hyougo, the true restaurant manager, returns to the store after another unsuccessful search for his lost wife; his wife, who has the world's worst sense of direction, got lost years ago while out shopping.
3.summary:
The Branch Manager, Otoo, returns to Wagnaria for the first time in a while. Everyone rejoices in the wide variety of souvenirs that he brings back—except for one vengeful nemesis.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 相馬, さわやか すぎる青年

4.overview: Takanashi is visited at work by one his 4 sisters.  Hiroomi the assistant cook attempts to blackmail the staff of Wagnaria so that he won't have to work.  At the same time it becomes apparent that Satou the head cook has a thing for Yachiyo the head waitress.
4.summary:
Soma takes care of everyone, and seems to simply be a super nice guy. Intrigued by Soma`s rich personality and knowledge about everyone, Sota soon learns all about his dangerous methods of "negotiation."
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ある風邪の日に..., いつもと違うワグナリア
title.en: One Windy Day, an Unusual Wagnaria.
title.x-jat: Aru Kaze no Hi ni..., Itsumo to Chigau Wagnaria

5.overview: Takanashi takes the day off work to take care of his sick sister.  The staff attempts to function without them and deal with Mahiru's fear of men with no male server to deal with the male customers.
5.summary:
Sota takes a day off work to take care of his younger sister, Nazuna, while she is sick in bed. In order to make up for his absense, everyone else jumps in to juggle Wagnaria`s hectic tasks. And just as the chaos reaches its apex...
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 宗太の憂鬱, 小鳥遊家の女達
title.en: Sota`s Melancholy, the Women of the Takanashi
title.x-jat: Souta no Yuuutsu, Takanashi-ke no Onna-tachi

6.overview:
Takanashi spends some quality time with his four quirky sisters; the boss, the drunk, the writer and the manipulative.  Each in their own way is reliant on Takanashi to keep their family in order.

White Day has arrived and Takanashi gifts Mahiru a bag of hair pins.  This is the first White Day gift she has ever received.  Later he runs into her on the street worried that she might attack some random male while walking around he escorts her home.  On the way they run into his eldest sister Kazue.  Mahiru get flustered and admits to "assaulting" Takanashi on a regular basis.
6.summary:
The Takanashis live in a typical home in Hokkaido. But, beneath the shell of a regular household lies a cruel hierarchy of power. Surrounded by predators (his older sisters), Sota lives a day-to-day struggle to survive.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 久しぶりの音尾と, 新しいバイト=山田(!?)
title.en: Long Time No See, Otoo! The New Part-Timer, Yamada!?
title.x-jat: Hisashiburi no Otoo to, Atarashii Baito = Yamada (!?)

7.overview:
Otoo returns to Wagnaria once again this time bringing with him a new waitress, Yamada Aoi.  Aoi tells a "tragic tale of woe" to which Takanashi responds that she is a liar.

Reluctantly he ends up training Aoi in how to be a waitress.  As the day progress she tries to assign the various staff members into a fake family structure.
7.summary:
Otoo is scheduled to return to Wagnaria today! Kyoko gets excited about receiving his usual, edible souvenirs and Sota jokes about the possibility that Otoo may bring something different back with him this time. He does. It`s a new employee.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 伊波, はじめて? のお・で・か・け!

8.overview:
The girls decided to take a trip to the hot springs which will be the first time for Mahiru.  Takanashi concerned about the fate of the male guests at the hot springs goes as well.

In the end the entire staff ends up going only to be so late that the hot spring is closed by the time they arrive.
8.summary:
When city maintenance forces the restaurant to close for a day, the staff decides to enjoy their day off by going to the hot springs. But, can Inami handle her androphobia in a popular tourist spot?
Source: crunchyroll

9.overview: The source of Mahiru's fear of men is revealed to be a plan concocted by her father.  Mahiru's father finds out that Takanashi gave her a gift for White Day and visits the restaurant to meet him.  Mahiru, afraid that he has come to make her quit working there, asks Takanashi to pretend to be a girl.  Takanashi mans up and wears a skirt.
9.summary:
Inami is supposed to have the day off, but she visits the restaurant and confides in her co-workers that she needs their help because she lied to her dad. Surprised by the revelation, Sota goes to extreme lengths to help her out.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 疑惑の真相..., なずな働く.
title.en: The Moment of Truth, Nazuna Dons the Apron!?

10.overview:
Kyouko is gone for a week on company business and in her absence Yachiyo attempts to "serve" Jun, which results in his heart being crushed even more.

Later Nazuna sees Takanashi and Mahiru walking home together and bribes Kyouko to let her work at the restaurant for the day to spy on Mahiru.  Mahiru eventually admits that she likes Takanashi, though Nazuna misinterprets this thinking that she was confirming that Takanashi was a masochist.
10.summary:
After the incident in the previous episode, Sota and Inami decide to work on curing her androphobia. To do so, they decide to walk home together. Along the way, they run into Sota`s younger sister, Nazuna, who becomes curious about their relationship.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: あの頃の二人, 八千代と佐藤. と, ようこそ小鳥遊[たかなし]家へ
title.en: The Way They Were... Yachiyo and Sato, Welcome to the Takanashis.
title.x-jat: Ano Koro no Futari, Yachiyo to Satou. to, Youkoso Takanashi Ke e

11.overview: Yamada tells a scary ghost story at the end of work and Mahiru is to scared to go home where she would be by herself.  Takanashi invites her over to spend the night at his house,  Yamada follows them there, claiming to be too scared even though she was the one who told the story in the first place.
11.summary:
Yachiyo, Sato and Kyoko find photos of themselves from years ago in a photo album that Soma brings to work. Sato and Yachiyo reminisce about how they first met at Wagnaria. Also, due to a ghost story that Yamada tells, an unforeseen incident transpires.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: なぜか!? の決戦前夜. 種島[たねしま]の恩返し
title.en: Eve of the Duel!? Taneshima`s Reciprocation.
title.x-jat: Naze ka!? no Kessen Zenya. Taneshima no Ongaeshi

12.overview:
Pupura finds out about Takanashis tall sisters and is upset with him for keeping these ideal women from her.  As punishment she sets him up to go on a date with Mahiru.

An experiment to see how much more man acclimated Mahiru has become concludes that if she can't punch Takanashi she'll kick him in the nuts.
12.summary:
Taneshima finds Sota`s student ID that he left at the restaurant. Knowing that he`ll need it the next day, she decides to deliver it to him at his house, not knowing the chaos doing so will bring upon Wagnaria the following day.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: デートと言う名の"決戦", 小鳥遊と伊波のそれから...
title.en: Date, the Final Showdown. Takanashi and Inami Ever After...
title.x-jat: Date to Iu Na no "Kessen", Takanashi to Inami no Sore kara...

13.overview:
Takanashi and Mahiru go on their "date".  The staff of the restaurant fearing for Takanashi safety concoct an elaborate plan to have him cross dress so that Mahiru would think of him as a girl and not hit him.

As the date comes to a close Takanashi comes to realize his true feelings for Mahiru and Mahiru receives the compliment of her life.
13.summary:
At Taneshima`s behest, Sota and Inami go on their first date. Though nervous, Inami arrives dressed to kill, whereas Sota arrives anticipating that he might just get killed. Oh, and meet another member of the staff who has been there all along!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ワグナリア~夏の大感謝祭~ 夜の部
ワグナリア~夏の大感謝祭~ 昼の部
